props.animation_script:
// @desc Revive: a gold circle opens under each target and feathers of light rise through them; the revive lands as the light peaks (shared by Life Charm and Phoenix Feather)

"use strict";

(async () => {

const CFG = {

MV: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/RPG%20Maker%20MV/",

clip: "049_revive_1.webm", // gold circle + rising feathers, 1.67 s at 1x

clipAnchor: { x: 0.4982, y: 0.8394 }, // manifest anchor = the ground point

clipSizeFrac: 2.4, // clip width as a fraction of the target token width

clipRate: 0.7, // slower = calmer rise

glowColor: 'rgba(255,236,170,1)',

glowSizeFrac: 1.8, // warm glow on the body as the light peaks

glowAlpha: 0.85,

glowInMs: 600,

glowHoldMs: 500,

glowOutMs: 1100,

fireDoneAtMs: 1300, // revive lands as the feathers peak (~55% of the slowed clip)

sfx: "Raise1",

volume: 0.8,

};

const P = payload ?? globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const casterUuid = P.casterTokenUuid ?? P.sourceTokenUuid ?? null;

const targetUuids = (P.targetTokenUuids ?? (P.targets ?? []).map((t) => t.tokenUuid) ?? []).filter(Boolean);

const doneHook = "oni:done:" + foundry.utils.randomID(8);

const onceHook = (name, ms) => new Promise((resolve) => {

const id = Hooks.once(name, () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(); });

const t = setTimeout(() => { Hooks.off(name, id); resolve(); }, ms);

});

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationStart", { local: true, world: false });

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const list = oni.targets.length ? oni.targets : (oni.caster ? [oni.caster] : []);

if (!list.length) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const layer = oni.layer({ zIndex: 95500 });

oni.sfx(cfg.sfx, { volume: cfg.volume });

let fired = false;

const gate = setTimeout(() => { if (!fired) { fired = true; oni.fireDone(); } }, cfg.fireDoneAtMs);

const one = async (target) => {

const tw = target.w || 100, th = target.h || 100;

const cx = target.center.x, feetY = target.y + th;

const fx = await oni.vfx(cfg.MV + cfg.clip, { x: cx, y: feetY, size: tw * cfg.clipSizeFrac, zIndex: 96000 });

if (fx) {

fx.sprite.anchor.set(cfg.clipAnchor.x, cfg.clipAnchor.y);

fx.sprite.position.set(cx, feetY);

try { fx.video.playbackRate = cfg.clipRate; } catch (e) {}

}

const glow = new PIXI.Sprite(oni.radialTexture(cfg.glowColor, 'rgba(255,236,170,0)', { size: 256 }));

glow.anchor.set(0.5);

glow.width = glow.height = tw * cfg.glowSizeFrac;

glow.position.set(cx, target.center.y);

glow.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

glow.alpha = 0;

layer.addChild(glow);

await oni.wait(Math.max(0, cfg.fireDoneAtMs - cfg.glowInMs));

await oni.tween({ from: 0, to: cfg.glowAlpha, duration: cfg.glowInMs, ease: oni.EASE.inOutQuad, onUpdate: (v) => (glow.alpha = v) });

await oni.wait(cfg.glowHoldMs);

await Promise.all([

oni.tween({ from: glow.alpha, to: 0, duration: cfg.glowOutMs, ease: oni.EASE.inOutQuad, onUpdate: (v) => (glow.alpha = v) }),

fx ? fx.ended : Promise.resolve(),

]);

};

await Promise.all(list.map(one));

if (!fired) { fired = true; clearTimeout(gate); oni.fireDone(); }

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "anim-studio/revive",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: casterUuid,

targetTokenUuids: targetUuids,

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG },

});

await onceHook(doneHook, CFG.fireDoneAtMs + 6000);

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationEnd", { local: true, world: false });

})();
props.description: Shared animation: the revive cinematic. Played through a play_animation step (action_ref Item.FxShared0Revive1) by Life Charm and Phoenix Feather. Not an action of its own.
